gaps.sentence: This is ___ second time you've been late this week.
I saw ___ film last night, and the film was about mountain climbers.
gaps.hint: first mention of one of many
gaps.explanation: First mention of a countable noun takes 'a'; the second mention becomes 'the' (already written out here).

gaps.sentence: ___ Hyde Park is lovely in autumn.
gaps.explanation: Most park names take no article: Hyde Park, Central Park (exception: the Grands Boulevards style names).

gaps.sentence: He had ___ operation on his knee last year.
gaps.explanation: 'Operation' starts with a vowel sound, so 'an operation'.
'The courage he showed' — the relative clause makes it definite.

gaps.sentence: He was sent to ___ prison for armed robbery.
gaps.explanation: 'Be sent to prison' (as a prisoner) takes no article; visiting the building is 'go to the prison'.

gaps.sentence: ___ number of applicants has doubled this year.
gaps.explanation: 'The number of' takes a singular verb ('has'); 'a number of' would take 'have'.

gaps.sentence: These apples cost two euros ___ kilo.
gaps.explanation: 'A/per' is used for rates: two euros a kilo, twice a week, 60 km an hour.
